result:
My verdict is **PASS** on DG1 round 5, candidate `sha256:24eb377939d83b7036e992e647f390b91e030cd6aa18b805b74dea900d50b08e`. I found nothing new at any severity: no Critical, High, Medium or Low findings, and no mandatory violations.

**Candidate check.** HEAD is `d3fcb89`, not the named freeze commit `5f83a33`. It is the freeze commit's direct child and only adds round-5 assignments, the candidate manifest, `stages.json` and two QA evidence probes. None of those count towards the candidate ID. The recomputed ID matches the frozen one exactly, both in the working tree and in a clone at `5f83a33`, with no files added, removed or changed. The repository is not shallow. I treated this as matching rather than BLOCKED because the common assignment expects HEAD to carry this metadata on top of the freeze commit.

**No regression from the F-DG1-124 refactors.**
- **Same behaviour as round 4:** I compared the old and new versions of the four refactored functions directly (the cursor and filter-hash code, the approval-permission check and the status-transition rule). They gave identical results on 20,000 random inputs, every permission and all 16 status pairs. A cursor issued by the old code still works under the new code.
- **Closure still refused:** on a running stack, closing a record by a status edit is still refused with 422 citing G6. Nothing is written and no audit row is created. The edit form never offers "closed", in Arabic or English.
- **Scoped access holds:** a Transformation Lead scoped to one business unit can read what it creates. It gets 404 on a record outside its scope, sees only its own record in the list, and holds no gate or Finance approval permission.
- **Pagination works:** I created 9 records and paged through them in pages of 2 for all six sort orders. Each order came out complete, with no duplicates or gaps. A cursor reused with another filter, a tampered cursor, and an unknown sort (e.g. `__proto__`) are all refused with 400, never 500.
- **Identity routes hold:** prototype-named cookies (`__proto__`, `constructor` and similar) get 401, never a 500. Sign-in, sign-out, and the OIDC callback returning 404 in dev mode all work.

**Round-4 closures still hold** (F-DG1-001/002/003/004/005/006/105/007/008/207/009/210):
- **Integration suite:** two full runs on fresh PostgreSQL 16.13 clusters both passed 200/200 tests. No scratch databases were left behind and the server logs had no FATAL lines.
- **Unit suites:** 267/267 passed.
- **Arabic and English screens:** the audit trail is localised, and untranslated codes stay visibly marked. After creating a record, the Edit and Archive controls appear without a page reload. I looked at the screenshots myself.
- **Register:** `requirements.csv` is unchanged since round 4, and the register-text fixes are still in place.

**Unchanged invariants.**
- `#0078FF` and the other brand tokens are served as provisional, and the header shows a provisional wordmark.
- The only PMI or official-Mobily wording is the disclaimers saying the product is neither.
- Arabic renders right-to-left and English left-to-right, and the two catalogues have exactly the same keys.
- No request leaves the app's own origin (fonts are bundled), and the no-CDN check passes.
- The database has no floating-point columns.
- Missing data shows as Unknown, never zero or green.
- DG0–DG7 appear only in code comments and test names, never in the product UI.

**Requirements.** All 8 assigned DG1-final rows (REQ-S15-002/005/006, REQ-S16-001/002/004, REQ-S19-004/006) are IMPLEMENTED, and every evidence path they cite exists. The other playbook, §15 and §16 rows with a P1 increment have later final gates. They are honestly marked SPECIFIED, not claimed as delivered.

One caveat on how I ran the checks: an offline dependency install failed, so I copied the repository's installed `node_modules` into the disposable clone. The lockfile is identical. The clone was removed afterwards.

I wrote no verifications sidecar because I had no open findings to verify this round. I grant no business, Finance or IT approval, and product gate G6 does not imply DG7.

The review record (schema-valid) is at `docs/delivery/reviews/DG1/round-5/domain-reviewer.json`, and the evidence, including 12 screenshots, is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/domain/round-5/`.
